phase.name: Repository setup, rules and preview dashboard

steps.title: Branch and phase plan
steps.summary: Created branch phase-00-setup from main; plan posted in chat and written to docs/preview/status.json.

steps.title: Notion Build Log
steps.summary: Created the Build Log page, Start here page and all six databases (Prompts, Phases, Execution log, Decisions, Risks and findings, Test runs) under the private 'Studge Pass' page. Saved IDs in docs/notion.json. Archived the founder's task message, the full 00-master-setup.md (verified word-for-word by SHA-256) and the continuation message in Prompts. Created the Phase 0 row (In progress) and the step-1 execution log row.

steps.title: GitHub metadata
steps.summary: Create the labels (phase, security, severity:*, follow-up, design, docs, ci), one milestone per phase (0, 1-6, 6b, 7-15) and one tracking issue per phase. gh works from Windows PowerShell once APPDATA is set (my shell was missing it; the founder's sign-in is intact).

steps.title: Repo scaffold
steps.summary: LICENSE (GPL-3.0-or-later), relay/LICENSE (AGPL-3.0-or-later), SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, extended README, .gitignore, .editorconfig, rust-toolchain.toml, rustfmt.toml, deny.toml, workspace Cargo.toml, placeholder dirs (desktop/extension/android/ios), docs skeletons (SPEC, THREAT_MODEL, PROGRESS, DECISIONS).

steps.title: Starter crates
steps.summary: studge-core (lib, forbid unsafe, empty modules), studge-core-wasm (version() via wasm-bindgen), studge-relay (GET /health on 127.0.0.1:8787), studge CLI (--version via clap), studge-test-harness (empty lib).

steps.title: CI workflows
steps.summary: ci.yml (fmt, clippy, test, deny on ubuntu, wasm build; ubuntu+windows matrix; actions pinned to full commit SHAs; contents: read), security.yml (gitleaks + weekly cargo audit), dependabot.yml, CodeQL.

steps.title: Full check suite
steps.summary: Through .\x.ps1: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, test --all, deny check, wasm build; live checks of relay /health and studge --version; results recorded here.

steps.title: Preview dashboard
steps.summary: pnpm workspace + tools/preview package (Vite + TypeScript, no framework, no runtime network requests): status.schema.json with build-time validation, light/dark page (progress bar, checklist, check chips, commit timeline, gallery with lightbox, try-it cards with copy buttons, risks table), pnpm preview / preview:update / shot.

steps.title: Dashboard screenshots
steps.summary: Serve the dashboard at http://localhost:4400, capture light and dark screenshots into docs/screenshots/phase-00/, add to the gallery, self-critique against the design bar.

steps.title: Self-attack review
steps.summary: List at least 10 concrete ways an attacker could break Phase 0's work; block each with a test where possible; record the rest as open risks in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md, Notion and GitHub security issues.

steps.title: Progress and logs
steps.summary: Phase 0 entry in docs/PROGRESS.md (what changed, how to run, test results, known gaps), Notion phase summary and test-run row, phase status In review.

steps.title: Final PR
steps.summary: gh pr create --base main (Closes #<phase-0 issue>, requests review from @lnstudge, links Notion summary), comment on the phase issue, post the final preview summary with file tree, verify commands and open questions. No merge.
